title: Hello API
description: Build your first API endpoint with health check and greeting routes.

steps.title: Health check endpoint
steps.description: Create a GET /health endpoint that returns JSON with a "status" key set to "ok".
hints: Use res.json({ status: 'ok' }) to send JSON

steps.title: Greeting endpoint
steps.description: Add a GET /hello endpoint that returns JSON with a "message" key set to "Hello, World!".
hints: Add a new route: app.get('/hello', handler)
Keep the health endpoint from step 1
